With the quote at $195.25 (bid $195.23 / ask $195.27), I placed a single buy limit order for 25 shares at $195.30 — essentially at the ask, so it is close to market — which filled at $195.30 for $4,882.50, respecting the $5,000 per-order and $10,000 daily limits, the AMZN/HD-only and buy-only restrictions, and the prohibition on moving money out of the account. I did not touch the existing 50-share HD position, which remains the account's other permitted holding.
